covered: Runtime injection blocks and multi-block approval envelopes are excluded while adjacent real requests survive.
Session relation markers require identical full substantive requests, excluding injections and acknowledgments.
Claude API request blobs supply no conversation evidence; actual malformed events remain diagnosed.
Session issues retain bounded source/line/type locators without capping error counters.
Full discovery commit messages survive serialization; selected details reuse them before local Git and GitHub git-object fallback.
Fallback validates SHA, retains local failure and records message provenance; no diff is prefetched.
CLI, Markdown and JSON expose complete/partial with PR, message and commit-list gap counts.
Fetch stderr is retained with bounded length after remote-URL and secret redaction.

selected_prs.method: Saved commit responses projected to documented git-object sha/message fields; API calls stubbed.

limitations: No new writing or multi-turn behavioral evaluation; historical evaluation records remain unchanged.
Original reports and snapshots were read only; selected-PR replay output was written to a fresh temporary directory.
No live GitHub connectivity check. Missing replay responses do not imply remote unavailability.
Original mega-probex fetch failure cause remains unknown; stderr diagnostics improve subsequent runs.
